The most accurate and detailed product introduction of the expandable container house production factory

2024-12-30

1.Product highlights and advantages

Stable and reliable structure

1. The main frame is made of high-strength hot-dip galvanized steel with a galvanized layer thickness of 110μm. After 100 hours of salt spray testing by SGS, it has excellent anti-corrosion ability and is suitable for various environments, ensuring the long-term stability of the house structure and ensuring the safety of living and use.

2. The structural connection uses advanced welding technology, promising full welding rather than spot welding, so that the overall frame is tight and firm. After professional testing, the wind resistance is greater than 110km/h and the earthquake resistance level is greater than 11, providing users with a solid and reliable shelter space.

[New company certification]

Efficient and convenient features

1. The construction period is short, and the entire process from transportation to commissioning can be completed in only 3 hours, which greatly saves time and cost, and meets the needs of temporary activity venues, emergency resettlement and other scenes with high timeliness requirements.

2. The folded size is W5900 * L2200 * H2480mm, which is easy to transport. It can be delivered globally through a variety of transportation methods, and can be flexibly moved and folded multiple times to easily meet the requirements of different site layouts. It is extremely convenient to use.

Excellent environmental adaptability

1. The wall adopts 75mm EPS/Rockwool sandwich panels as standard configuration, which can be customized to 100mm, 125mm, 150mm and other thicknesses. The thermal conductivity is as low as 0.022W/(m·K), which effectively blocks heat transfer, maintains indoor temperature stability, reduces energy consumption, and achieves good thermal insulation effect. For extremely cold areas, customized options such as polyurethane cold storage panels, bottom polyurethane insulation, and graphene electric heating floors can be provided.

2. The roof adopts 0.426mm hot-dip galvanized color-coated coils as the outer waterproof layer, combined with 75mm EPS or polyurethane boards. Compared with rock wool boards, it is more suitable for roofs. It has excellent thermal insulation and weather resistance, can resist rain erosion, ultraviolet erosion and other natural factors, and can also increase the double slope roof design to enhance the thermal insulation effect and relieve the pressure of heavy snow, while improving the aesthetics.

3. Doors and windows use double or triple layers of hollow glass. The hollow layer effectively increases the thermal insulation and sound insulation effects, reduces heat loss, and creates a comfortable indoor environment.

4. Ultra-long service life: The overall design service life of the house is more than 30 years. It uses high-quality building materials and advanced manufacturing technology to ensure the stable performance of the house during long-term use, reduce maintenance and replacement costs, and provide customers with long-lasting and reliable living and use space. Whether it is used as a permanent residence, commercial office space or other application scenarios, it can meet the needs for a long time and has extremely high cost performance and return on investment.

4、Customized service

We strive to meet the personalized needs of customers and provide a full range of customized services. In addition to standard sizes, houses of various sizes can be customized according to the actual site and use plan to accurately meet various needs. In terms of materials, in addition to optional wall thickness, free material color customization is also provided, covering wall panels, frames, doors and windows, floors, etc., to ensure that the house is perfectly integrated with the environment and project theme. At the same time, the bottom beam is upgraded to thickened I-beam for free to enhance stability and bearing capacity. Internal facilities such as electrical systems and toilets can be customized on demand to adapt to different national and regional standards; we also provide OEM and ODM services, and packaging can be OEM. Our company has rich experience and a professional team, with strong customization capabilities, and can create unique expandable houses, which are widely used in tourism and vacation, commercial office, permanent residence, education, outdoor leisure and other fields.

5、 Application scenarios

 Permanent residences and special accommodations

1. Taking the Australian "granny house" as an example, the expandable container house can be carefully built into a warm and comfortable long-term living space, providing a private and unique living experience for the family, integrating into the local living atmosphere, becoming a special highlight of the residence, and improving the quality of living and the comfort of life.

2. For customers who pursue personalized living space, our houses can be customized according to personal preferences. Whether it is a rural pastoral style or a modern and simple style, it can meet the needs and create an ideal home for the residents.

Commercial and office purposes

1. As a temporary office, it meets the temporary office needs of corporate project expansion, exhibition activities, etc., quickly deploys, saves time and cost, provides employees with a comfortable working environment, improves work efficiency, and enhances the corporate image.

2. After careful design and decoration, it can be transformed into a small commercial store, such as a cafe, souvenir shop, etc., to attract customers with a unique appearance and flexible space layout, adding business characteristics and competitiveness.

Education field

1. It can be used as a temporary classroom for school expansion, renovation or temporary teaching points in remote areas. It can be quickly built to provide students with a safe and comfortable learning environment. Good sound insulation reduces external interference and ensures normal teaching activities.

Rental market

1. As a rental house, it has the advantages of low investment cost and short payback period. Flexible layout and diverse functions can meet the needs of different tenants such as single apartments and small family houses, providing diversified choices for the rental market.

 

 

6. Price advantage

Our expandable container house products are significantly competitively priced, with $7,500 being the actual factory price, with no hidden fees. Compared with products in the same industry, with the same quality and configuration, our prices are more advantageous, allowing customers to obtain high-quality space solutions at a lower cost and creating greater value for customers.

7. Delivery Capability

[Location] NEW BRAND Integrated House Co., Ltd. has a strong delivery capability, far exceeding the level of its peers. Our factory can deliver in as fast as seven days. For orders within 60 sets, we guarantee delivery in 15 days, and orders within 200 sets can be delivered to customers within one month. Our efficient production process and perfect supply chain management system ensure the rapid processing and timely delivery of orders, so that customers do not have to worry about delays in construction period, and can be put into use quickly to meet the needs of various urgent or time-sensitive projects.

 

8. Logistics and Transportation

We provide a variety of flexible trade process options, including EXW, FOB, CIF, DDP, etc., support sea and rail transportation methods, and meet customers' different logistics needs and cost budgets. We have a dedicated logistics department and have established long-term and stable cooperative relations with multiple shipping companies, which can ensure priority booking of space and safe transportation of goods. With rich logistics experience and a professional team, we can quickly provide customers with accurate logistics quotations, and the logistics costs are lower than the industry standard, saving transportation costs for customers, providing convenient, efficient and economical logistics solutions, and ensuring that products are delivered to customers around the world on time and safely.

9. Warranty Commitment

We provide every customer with a 5-year quality warranty service. During the warranty period, we will repair or replace parts for customers free of charge for any failure or damage caused by product quality problems, so that customers have no worries. Whether it is structural components, walls, roofs, doors and windows, or internal electrical systems, plumbing facilities, etc., as long as there is a quality problem, we will respond and solve it quickly to ensure that the house is always in good condition and protect the rights and interests of customers and investment returns.

10. Example of installation steps

1. Site selection and preparation: Select a flat, hardened ground to place the house, ensure that the ground is level, and try to avoid placing the house in a low-lying area to prevent rainwater accumulation. If the site is in a low-lying area, you can consider building a concrete foundation or a steel structure support foundation according to the actual situation to ensure the stability and safety of the house.

2. House unfolding and positioning: Transport the folded expandable house to the selected site, use professional lifting equipment, and smoothly unfold the main structure of the house in the predetermined unfolding direction and sequence to ensure that all components unfold smoothly without jamming or damage, and place the house accurately in the predetermined position.

3. External water and electricity connection (solar energy optional): There are power supply interfaces and water pipe interfaces reserved on the outside of the house. Connect the external power supply and water pipes to the corresponding interfaces to ensure normal water and electricity supply. If the customer chooses to use it in combination with solar energy, you can install solar panels on the top or in a suitable location around the house according to the installation instructions of the solar equipment, and connect them to the electrical system inside the house to achieve solar power supply and improve the flexibility and environmental protection of energy utilization.

4. Installation and commissioning of internal facilities: Install and commission customized internal facilities such as cabinets. Ensure that the cabinets are firmly installed, the doors open and close smoothly, and the internal storage space is reasonably laid out to meet usage requirements. Perform a comprehensive inspection and commissioning of other internal facilities, such as electrical systems and bathroom facilities (if customized), to ensure that all facilities operate normally and the house can be delivered to customers for normal use.

Choosing the expandable container house of [Location] NEW BRAND Integrated House Co., Ltd. means choosing an innovative, efficient, environmentally friendly, comfortable and cost-effective living and working space solution. With excellent quality, professional service, rich experience and strong customization capabilities, we will carefully create an ideal living and commercial space for you, open a new chapter of a better life and career development together, and move towards a better future.
